references.scope: functional reference only: queued work, result timeout, local pub/sub event sources
functional reference only: language runtime packaging
functional reference only: pinned/on-demand, timeoutInSeconds, maxInstancesCount, maxQueueSize, eventSources, isolation

modes.on-demand: one new process per invocation; up to max_concurrency (1..64) at once; process group and escaped descendants killed after the response
modes.long-lived: one process started with the manager; serial invocations; restarted with backoff after exit, timeout or protocol violation

admission: FIFO per function: invoke below max_concurrency, else queue up to max_queue (default 1000), else busy; max_pending (default 256) bounds accepted outstanding work
timeout: elapsed milliseconds from dispatch at or above timeout_ms is timeout; the process group is killed
routing: exact authenticated sender == source and exact topic == subject; sorted unique function targets; no match acknowledges without invocation
delivery: message journaled (SQLite FULL) before acknowledgement; duplicate redelivery acknowledged without invocation; interrupted invocations re-run with attempt+1 (at least once); completed results republished without reinvocation
isolation: Linux: optional run_as uid/gid without supplementary groups, cleared environment, private work directory, no ambient capabilities, no_new_privs, no core files, optional RLIMIT_AS, parent-death SIGKILL, manager subreaper sweep
live_aws: unrun; no AWS account, Lambda service, recipe or SDK compatibility; separate authorization required; tracked in SF-069/#123
license: clean-room original implementation from public documentation; no AWS component code, binaries or runtime images copied or executed
